_readme: Dwell is per-artifact (L-013): one cycle of the artifact's own process, in seconds. Sources, in precedence order: (1) 'artifacts' declarations below (hand-ruled or measured), (2) 'defaults' by desire kind. Consumed by tools/desire_timeline.py — the map's experienced runtime = locomotion time + sum of dwells. Declare freely; measurement passes can overwrite the 'measured' block later, declarations always win.
